name: Elemental Fear
body:
School necromancy [fear, mind-affecting]; Level arcanist 4, sorcerer/wizard 4

CASTING

Casting Time 1 standard action
Components V, S

EFFECT

Range see text
Area special
Duration see text
Saving Throw see text; Spell Resistance no

DESCRIPTION

Note: This spell was designed to be used by dragons, thus it may alter or replace core dragon abilities (like frightful presence etc.)

Twisting the knife of fear even deeper into your victim, your frightful presence causes actual harm. If a target is affected by your frightful presence, it takes one point of damage per round for the duration of the frightful presence effect. The type of damage is the same as your breath weapons. If you do not have a breath weapon, this effect deals slashing damage instead.

Book of Magic: Dragon Spells and Archetypes. 2017, Jon Brazer Enterprises
